detail: Issue pinpoints startswith(env_prefix) lacking separator in TomlReplaceLoader._config_value_sources; all 6 F2P tests verify resolution of envvars, environment, and env_base tables.
Issue explains missing face_edge_connectivity in isel; base repo test_indexing.py already shows commented-out ds_edge expectations for both UxDataArray and sibling UxDataset.
Core choice previous_value bug is clear, but nested-assignment test hinges on an unanswered design question in the issue (prior assignment vs prior delivered event).
Core finish_reason rejection is clear, but 2/5 real F2P tests assert unmentioned RuntimeError regex 'incomplete conversation summary (finish reason: ...)'.
Issue specifies making aggregate string subscripts match dotted properties; materializing constant string SubscriptExpr like PropertyAccessExpr in pattern_where_properties passes all 7 F2P tests.
Issue explicitly maps cudaThreadIdx, cudaBlockIdx, and cudaBlockDim to gl_LocalInvocationID, gl_WorkGroupID, and gl_WorkGroupSize; all 5 F2P tests check that exact lowering.
7/9 F2P tests require normalizing uppercase/mixed-case --hash digests to lowercase (and reusing envs), an unmentioned requirement beyond accepting [a-fA-F0-9].
All 4 F2P tests require exact wording 'Storage on the server is full', contradicting the issue's own example 'Storage is full. Free up space and try again.'.
Test checks exact repro input/output (provider 'nous' and base_url); issue's suggested snippet discards provider instead of stripping pin, but testing repro reveals the needed fix.
All 4 F2P tests check non-SPDX descriptive/mixed-case text returns 'name', passing under standard SPDX validation.
All 3 F2P tests check gateway status_code=502/503/400 extraction matching the issue and existing streaming-error helper pattern in error_utils.py.
All 7 F2P tests assert exact unmentioned warning/error strings ('1 of 2 hyperparameter combinations raised an error' and 'resulted in a NaN `metric` score or raised an error').
All 21 F2P tests assert a newly invented 'Encountered (x, y, ...) <type> components' error format without index 1, contradicting the issue's stated fix and existing tests.
6 of 9 F2P tests call private _number_of_sentences_to_keep with an unmentioned renamed keyword parameter 'overlap_word_budget' instead of existing 'split_length'.
Both F2P tests verify multi-component MGA under linopy v1; fixing sibling optimize_mga_in_direction alongside build_linexpr_from_weights in mga.py is inferable from callers.
Both F2P tests verify exact URL path percent-encoding repro cases explicitly specified in the issue for CompatRestTransport.
Issue reports a false-positive warning with no material modifications, but sole F2P test asserts a newly broadened warning in _constructMaterial not described in the issue.
3 F2P tests check the exact retry repro and 3 check the identical sibling CommitWindow.resolve block 22 lines above in Transaction.commit_transaction.
All 3 F2P tests verify unary and streaming non-2xx JSON-RPC error body mapping explicitly specified in the issue.
Issue specifies SqlCatalog(name, engine=engine, **properties) with optional uri and explicit usage example; both tests match directly.
Issue specifies preserving comments inside redundant ELSE NULL on their own line after the last WHEN clause; both end-to-end tests match.
Issue leaves *@ exclusion mechanism unspecified and requests conan create packages follow build_type, contradicting tests that only exclude unnamed consumers from *@ directly.
Issue explicitly requests changing is_series_like from hasattr('dropna') to a type-based TypeGuard excluding DataFrames; single test matches directly.
Issue leaves two open alternatives and never names _JointType; hidden test patch imports _JointType at module level, breaking all 18 tests with ImportError.
Issue gives exact reproduction, expected wrapped output with opening-line comments, and root cause in _build_as_imports; single regression test matches.
Issue identifies generic_struct_specialized_fields and sibling generic_vector_deduction fix for vecN<T> struct members; array members are a clear sibling in generic_struct_member_type_name.
Issue leaves single-item caption hyperlink handling open and omits *bold* title collapsing; 5/6 tests require exact _caption_text hyperlink heuristic or single-item bold collapsing.
Issue specifies every invalid profile value, 400 'invalid profile' response via _PROFILE_ID_RE, and rejecting before creation/caching; all 6 F2P tests match.
Issue specifies zeroing empty brace enum initializers for CrossGL and CUDA inputs across backends; codebase emits plain enums as int/i32 even with ': uint'.
Issue explicitly leaves exposing vs dropping exit_reason as an open design choice (and existing test/docstring favor dropping), while the sole F2P test requires exposing it.
13/14 tests depend on unmentioned new helper hub_client.forward_tool_call and its exact (handled, result) tuple contract (and no-retry policy on unanswered hub).
Core non-finite-as-0 behavior is clear, but 1/6 test requires an unrequested WARNING containing exact text 'have a non-finite score' and doc IDs.
Issue clearly describes out-of-range get_estimator arguments succeeding for native multi-output models; moving existing ValueError checks before the early return passes all assertions.
tests/test_downloads.py top-level imports unmentioned new helper fromager.downloads.sdist_extension_for_url, causing ImportError across all 22/27 F2P tests in that module.
Issue thoroughly specifies pandas 3.1 nullable Int64/UInt64 ID loss in GFQL fallback; all 9 tests assert only public hop/gfql rows and dtypes.
Sole test accesses newly hoisted class attribute solvers.Cplex.CONDITION_MAP (previously local to _run_file) and requires exact status 'imprecise' not specified in the issue.
Both tests require bytes regex patterns to match UTF-8 comments, unmentioned in issue and contradicting base code/tests that explicitly raised TypeError on bytes patterns.
4/7 tests import unmentioned normalize.codex_response_message and test undocumented metadata/image-tag rules; 1 more tests unmentioned subagent exclusion via session_meta.payload.source.subagent.
Issue clearly explains channel_props submodule shadowing and suggests __setattr__ fix; all 8 tests check only public attribute callability and __name__.
Issue clearly specifies preserving Oracle TO_DATE/TO_TIMESTAMP nlsparam third argument; single test checks only SQL round-trip identity with no internal assertions.

Issue scopes fix to skipping _collapsed_partials save in Session.load; 12/16 tests require unmentioned _sidecar_names_other_session attr, RuntimeError(match='8852') in save(), and refusals across 6 other paths.
Issue names _shift_manifest_byte_ranges and exact byte slicing for inlined chunks; single F2P test checks sliced shape, _inlined bytes, and reference offset/length.
2/3 F2P tests call sbom.generate_sbom with unmentioned keyword argument wheel_version; wheels.py calls the variable dist_version and issue never names generate_sbom's signature.
All 6 F2P tests require unmentioned attribute names AQUA_flipped (renaming existing flipped) and AQUA_rolled with exact integer shift, despite issue allowing multiple fix approaches.
Issue repro tests Record(nan) == Record(nan) and pinpoints Record.__eq__ breaking DeleteFileIndex and _validate_data_files_exist; all 3 F2P tests check those exact behaviors.
Issue clearly explains CompatRestTransport.get_extended_agent_card misparses v0.3 JSON card as proto and drops security; single F2P test checks preserved security schemes and requirements.
1/2 F2P tests modifies an existing test to require rewriting dict examples in param['schema']['examples'] to a list, unmentioned in issue and contradicting base tests.
Issue pinpoints Transaction._stage dropping second AssertRefSnapshotId across branches; all 6 F2P tests directly verify per-ref assertion staging and concurrent-change retry behavior.
Issue specifies exact KeyError location and expected per-period storage emission weighting in define_primary_energy_limit; all 4 F2P tests check resulting optimal storage levels.
Issue only reports RecursionError under evaluate(False), but 2/3 F2P tests assert unrelated Float complex precision and nested Mul rational-cancellation behavior from evalf_mul rewrite.
Issue leaves union/empty policy open and omits root-page string annotations; tests assert unmentioned root-page string annotation resolution and exact new caplog error string.
Issue specifies exact REST route GET /v1/tasks/{id}/pushNotificationConfigs and sibling transport implementations; single F2P test checks that exact request and parsed config list.
Issue identifies define_piecewise MultiIndex snapshot bug and notes efficiency; all 3 F2P tests only check objective matches linear equivalent.
Issue reports AttributeError on ForeignObjectRel; skipping ForeignObjectRel in _model_fields directly generalizes existing ManyToOneRel/ManyToManyRel check and passes both F2P tests.
Issue blames converting explicit 0 to jump; 2/4 F2P tests require also keeping trailing implicit jumps on U cards and formatting unset universe-0 as exact '4J'.
Issue specifies guarding list processors with nearing_recursion_limit() like BlockQuoteProcessor; all 4 F2P tests check no RecursionError, bounded nesting, and preserved text.
Issue specifies check_stationarity: bool = True parameter skipping stationarity_tests(); both F2P tests check iterable maxlag and existing warning suppression.
Single F2P test asserts exact mathematical discriminants of the two algebraic fields given in the issue reproducer.
Issue asks to pass trace_state and fix root update_trace_state; 16/25 F2P tests require unmentioned threshold-vs-sampled consistency checking and deleting empty ot keys.
Single F2P test runs the exact issue reproducer and asserts the stated -1 constraint labels and [10, 10] solution.
test_default_app_undefined asserts unstated error regex and TOML key default_app (issue writes default-app); dev -a test also requires unstated menu default change.
Issue is an empty CI tracking ticket linking an inaccessible Actions run; all 5 F2P tests require unmentioned env vars, bytecode caching, and pausing schedule.
Lowering function-typed generics follows Vera's spec and codebase; all 23 tests check clean compilation and execution without unguessable specifics.
Issue offers an alternative AvdId-scan fix failing all tests; even reading .ini hits base-test fallback traps and unstated path.rel precedence.
Issue examples specify 'python -m' without mentioning sys.executable; all 4 tests mock sys.executable='/usr/bin/python3' and assert 'python3 -m'.
Core unknown-first-char tests match the issue, but nested meta-of-meta intermediate collection handling for -fovjson is unmentioned scope.
Test 1 asserts unmentioned InvalidPartNumber message and XML fields; tests 2-3 assert unmentioned COMPOSITE/FULL_OBJECT checksum handling.
All 5 tests assert sensitive keys are omitted from session_properties, whereas the issue asks to redact values without specifying key deletion.
All 14 tests check standard Databricks SQL type predicates (string, integer, float, numeric, number) and aliases on DatabricksColumn.
Single graded test directly checks fire-and-forget run_javascript ordering against an awaited call as described in the issue.
Two tests require an unmentioned FutureWarning matching 'November 2026' when passing None; issue also leaves honor-vs-deprecate open.
All 4 tests check the identical .data.tolist() to .value.tolist() fix on TemplateSpectralModel and three obvious sibling model classes.
